fail_closed: Every one of 72*40+72*16+11+1 fields must be derived and compared; no parent report copy-as-prediction, omitted field, unknown null, extra row or revised formula after observation.
preconstruction_materialization: Before any package construction, a frozen PURE source must enumerate exactly 4044 field predicates with each table, row, column, type, formula and fixed numeric interval rule, and an independent method must test meaningful wrong-cell/null/bool/row/order/precision mutations. Unknown or unreconciled field is NO_GO.
